role_in_op: Main objective (platoon) of op 5 and the FOB for op 7's boat route. The lower town under the acropolis and the CIS supply port of the north: supply boats for the Yard load here. The garrison holds the quay and mole, the quay square under the port spire and the main street's upper bends toward the citadel.
approaches_text: From the sea: boats across the Kastro Strait into the bay; the mole and quay are the front. From the island: down the citadel road from the west, along the ridge lane from the power station (south-west) or the north lane from the fuel depot and the east-bay landers.

landmark.note: sci-fi port spire on the quay square: CIS cargo control for the north, its crown visible from the Kastro Strait
